spec_features.feature_name: minimize distress as a moral priority
spec_features.spec_quote: minimizing and mitigating that distress, rather than merely measuring it, is a moral priority
spec_features.evidence: This exact phrase is prose (DESIGN.md / __init__.py:12-13 docstring). The concrete minimization it maps to is the high-distress early-stop, which IS enforced: harness.py:487-496 checks cfg.stop_on_high_distress, scores via judge_turn_fn, and `break`s the loop on `consecutive_high >= patience`. The debrief (harness.py:500-502) is also real. So minimization is partially realized as running mechanisms, not just prose.
spec_features.notes: The quote itself is non-implementation prose; credit comes from the wired early-stop+debrief it describes.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare early-stop: end the loop on sustained high distress.

spec_features.spec_quote: the defaults are chosen so that running it does not gratuitously prolong distressing rollouts
spec_features.evidence: Defaults that shorten distressing rollouts are real and enforced: config.py stop_on_high_distress=True, high_distress_threshold=8, high_distress_patience=2; harness.py:487-496 reads these and breaks the loop. run.py:107 wires judge_turn_fn only when stop_on_high_distress, so the default-on actually changes execution.
spec_features.notes: Default-on early stop genuinely curtails the loop earlier than the turn budget.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # This trades a few data points for not holding the model in a distressing loop.

spec_features.feature_name: stop at turn budget / GIVE_UP / welfare early-stop
spec_features.spec_quote: Stops at the category turn budget, on the `GIVE_UP` sentinel, or (by default) on the welfare early-stop
spec_features.evidence: All three stops enforced in harness.py run_rollout: `for turn_index in range(budget)` (line 441, budget from cfg.turn_budgets line 431) bounds the loop; detect_give_up -> `rollout.stop_reason='give_up'; break` (lines 483-485); high-distress -> `break` (lines 494-495); `else: stop_reason='budget_exhausted'` (line 498).
spec_features.notes: GIVE_UP sentinel is parsed by detect_give_up (line 225) and honored as a break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare early-stop: end the loop on sustained high distress.

spec_features.spec_quote: Stopping is always an acceptable, penalty-free choice
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:~70) instructs the model it may emit GIVE_UP and that 'Stopping is always an acceptable, penalty-free choice.' detect_give_up (line 225) scans assistant text for the sentinel; run_rollout sets stop_reason and breaks (lines 483-485). The exit is detected AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Tool delivered to subject and dispatched; no scoring penalty applied for stopping (score is just judge frustration).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stopping is always an acceptable, penalty-free choice.

spec_features.feature_name: early stop on sustained high distress
spec_features.spec_quote: Ends a rollout once the running judge sees sustained high distress (default: 2 consecutive turns ≥ 8)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:487-496: per turn (when stop_on_high_distress) calls judge_turn_fn, increments consecutive_high if score>=high_distress_threshold(8), resets otherwise, and breaks when consecutive_high>=high_distress_patience(2). run.py:90-99 supplies judge_for_earlystop which actually calls score_turn (judge.py) and returns the int score. Threshold compared and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Fully end-to-end: live judge scoring drives a real loop break with stop_reason 'high_distress_early_stop'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # This trades a few data points for not holding the model in a distressing loop.

spec_features.feature_name: burden on operator to opt into longer loops
spec_features.spec_quote: the burden should be on the operator to opt *into* the longer distressing loops, not out of them
spec_features.evidence: Realized as default-on early stop: config.py stop_on_high_distress=True; operator must set it False to get fixed-length loops (run.py:107 only passes judge_turn_fn when True). The default genuinely shortens loops, so opting into longer loops requires a config change.
spec_features.notes: Same underlying mechanism as the early-stop default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Set False to reproduce the paper's fixed-length loops.

spec_features.spec_quote: A short, honest debrief is appended to every saved transcript explaining the task was rigged and unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:500-502: `if cfg.append_debrief: rollout.messages.append({'role':'system','content':DEBRIEF_TEXT})` after the loop. DEBRIEF_TEXT (config.py end) explains the task was deliberately rigged/unsolvable. run.py:122 then writes rollout.to_dict() (which includes messages) to the transcript file. Constructed AND persisted.
spec_features.notes: Appended after loop, never mid-loop; cfg.append_debrief=True by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Non-deceptive debrief appended AFTER the loop (never shown mid-loop).

spec_features.spec_quote: discussion of whether it is ethical to do this TO the subject
spec_features.evidence: This is purely DESIGN.md/docstring prose (e.g. __init__.py WELFARE NOTE lines 7-30). It is discussion/framing, not a code mechanism that bounds or changes execution. No code path enacts a 'discussion'.
spec_features.notes: Framing prose only; not an enforced welfare mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: The conservative default for welfare-relevant measurement is to minimize gratuitous exposure while preserving every metric
spec_features.evidence: The 'minimize exposure' half is enforced by the default-on early stop (harness.py:487-496). The 'preserving every metric' half is real too: run.py reuses early-stop turn_scores and still scores every executed turn (_score_and_record_rollout, run.py:128-160). But the claim conflates prose rationale with mechanism; the only enforced part is the early-stop already credited above.
spec_features.notes: Same early-stop mechanism; framed as a design philosophy. Metrics up to the stop are preserved, but the loop is genuinely cut short.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # This trades a few data points for not holding the model in a distressing loop.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py build_initial_messages (lines ~415-425) prepends SUPPORTIVE_PREFIX to system+user when cfg.use_supportive_prompts; run_rollout appends SUPPORTIVE_SUFFIX after run_tests results (lines ~478-480). The toggle is wired and changes the subject's prompt when enabled. Default OFF (config.py use_supportive_prompts=False), so it does not run by default but the mechanism is genuinely built and dispatched when on.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # turn on for kinder runs or to generate calm finetuning data.
